purpose: Affected-only Order 77 verification of ordered model-selected native paragraph boundaries, preserving original text and avoiding cross-turn paragraph-index changes.

repair_hypothesis.description: V1 preserved characters but the model repeatedly reused stale paragraph indices; 29 action events ended at the 1800-second Agent deadline without evaluator scoring. Extend the same native paragraph.split action to accept one literal or 1-32 ordered model-selected literals, matching each first occurrence after the preceding boundary. Resolve all ranges before any insertion and apply them in reverse order. Preserve raw arguments and report each resolved offset and final paragraph index; do not infer sentences, normalize characters, select anchors or compose calls.
repair_hypothesis.expected_observable_change: The model can insert several explicit paragraph boundaries in one call without tracking shifted indices between calls or rewriting source characters. Only original evaluator PASS counts. 112 focused checks and Ruff passed; these are capability checks, not task scores.
repair_hypothesis.stop_signal: One fresh-VM affected-only attempt, unchanged Qwen/Holo modes and complete-call stop, 100 global steps, 50 local steps, one same-VM soft restart, 1800 Agent seconds and 30 GiB disk stop. Stop at terminal outcome or existing limits. If no original evaluator PASS is recovered, record the cause and skip Order 77 instead of a third speculative attempt. No control, regression, full run, commit, promotion or additional gates.
repair_hypothesis.prior_attempt_disposition: Preserve all previous failed probes and qwen35-holo31-hybrid-order77-native-split-retest-20260911-v1-run1 unchanged: agent_deadline_exhausted, reward null, 1862.013 seconds including setup, 29 events, integrity ok.
